claim: The blanket 'ignore-with-warning on unknown schema versions' policy is copied from the routing-overrides precedent (an intentionally low-stakes exclusion-list format) but applied uniformly to routing.yaml, which also carries fail-closed trust-zone constraints -- degrading open on a version mismatch there is the opposite of fail-closed.
